Customizing Forms
#################

.. vale off

.. vale on

To provide custom Form Field templates or to manipulate the Form body, create the following directory structure::

    Field/ <– for customizing form field types
    html/
        MauticFormBundle/
            Builder/
                _style.html.twig  <– for customizing CSS for Form
                form.html.twig <– for customizing the form structure itself

Copy from ``app/bundles/FormBundle/Resources/views/Builder/form.html.twig`` into the Theme’s Builder directory and/or one or more of the fields templates in ``app/bundles/FormBundle/Resources/views/Field/*.html.twig`` into the Theme’s ``Field`` directory. Then customize to the desired layout.

You can add a custom style sheet to the Form by adding a ``_style.html.twig`` with your custom CSS to ``html/MauticFormBundle/Builder``. The best way is to copy the content of the default Form styles and modify them to your needs.

Customize field types
*********************

Create a new template in the ``Field`` directory to change HTML generated by field types.
The best way is to copy the original template from ``app/bundles/FormBundle/Resources/views/Field/*.html.twig`` and modify it.

Customize the base ``text.html.twig`` template
==============================================

Several field type templates, such as ``email.html.twig``, ``number.html.twig``, and ``textarea.html.twig``, include the base ``text.html.twig`` template. Each of them first looks for ``text.html.twig`` in your Theme's ``Field`` directory and falls back to ``@MauticForm/Field/text.html.twig`` when your Theme doesn't provide one.

To change the markup for all these field types, copy only ``text.html.twig`` into your Theme's ``Field`` directory and modify it. You don't need to copy or edit the templates that include it.
